items.exampleEn: A lion is a powerful beast.
items.exampleZh: 獅子是一種強大的野獸。

items.exampleEn: It is hot and wet in the jungle.

items.exampleZh: 閃電擊中了那棵高大的樹。

items.exampleEn: Small pieces of debris from space sometimes fall to Earth.
items.exampleZh: 太空中的一些小殘骸有時會掉到地球上。

items.exampleEn: The old palace has marble stairs.
items.exampleZh: 那座老宮殿有大理石階梯。
海洋動物需要乾淨的水。

items.exampleEn: Farming is hard work in the summer.
The farmer counts his herd every evening.
items.exampleZh: 農夫每天傍晚數一數他的牛群。

items.sentenceEn: The jungle is full of strange sounds at night.
items.sentenceZh: 叢林在夜裡充滿奇怪的聲音。

items.audioEn: My little brother is afraid of lightning, so he hides under his blanket during storms.
items.audioZh: 我弟弟很怕閃電，所以暴風雨時會躲進被子裡。
items.questionZh: 弟弟怕閃電，所以會怎麼做？
options: He runs to his parents' room.
He watches it from the window.
He turns on all the lights.

items.sentenceEn: We saw lightning far away over the sea.
items.sentenceZh: 我們看到遠處海上的閃電。

items.sentenceEn: This museum is about marine life.
items.sentenceZh: 這座博物館是關於海洋生物的。

items.stemEn: A ____ of elephants walked slowly to the river.
items.stemZh: 一群大象慢慢走向河邊。

items.stemEn: The statue in the square was cut from a block of white ____.
items.stemZh: 廣場上的雕像是用一塊白色大理石雕成的。

items.passageEn: My cousin works for a marine research center on the coast. She is also an experienced diver. Last month, after a busy summer weekend, she and her team cleaned up debris on the beach: broken wood, plastic, and even part of a boat. She told me that she once watched lightning light up the whole sky from the research boat. Before this job, she worked in a jungle, where she studied wild beasts like tigers and followed a herd of elephants. Her family has done farming for many years, so she grew up close to animals. In her free time, she makes small animal statues out of marble.
items.passageZh: 我的表親在海邊的一間海洋研究中心工作，也是一位經驗豐富的潛水員。上個月一個熱鬧的夏季週末過後，她和團隊清理了海灘上的殘骸：斷掉的木頭、塑膠，甚至還有船的一部分。她告訴我，她曾經在研究船上看著閃電照亮整片天空。在做這份工作之前，她在叢林裡工作，研究老虎之類的野獸，還跟著一群大象走。她家務農很多年了，所以她從小就跟動物很親近。空閒時，她會用大理石做小動物雕像。

questions.questionZh: 熱鬧的夏季週末過後，她的團隊做了什麼？
她以前在叢林裡做什麼？

items.promptZh: 我的祖父母以務農為生。
referenceEn: My grandparents made a living from farming.
rubricZh: farming 表示「務農、農業」，是不可數名詞，例如 make a living from farming 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式，說現在的事用現在式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 beast 造一個句子，說說故事或電影裡的野獸。
referenceEn: In my favorite story, a beast lives in a castle.
I was scared of the beast in that movie.
rubricZh: beast 表示「野獸」，可數名詞，例如 a terrible beast 等說法
說的是自己的經驗或喜好（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）
